question: Does degree3 add useful shallow-node evaluation quality conditional on the same learned unary and degree2 correction?
motivation: Full versus unary removes both degree2 and degree3. Its positive shallow-node scores cannot by themselves establish higher-order cubic value. Prior W4 degree3 evidence was negative/inconclusive; G5 training warrants a new bounded checkpoint-specific test.
openingRange: Development roots25..32, shared with the depth discriminator; not independent confirmation.
activation: After actual quadratic canonical/cache score and search oracles pass, and after current fixed direct/cubic-only games finish. Execute depth32 then these32.
scope: Inference-only head ablation, no training or model writes. Equal nodes only: existing cache still computes unused third moments, so its latency cannot establish an optimized quadratic cost.
stopRule: Finish fixed32 games. No favourable-result extension. Failures stop the affected batch with all evidence preserved.
limitations: Only8 opening pairs per comparison; prior selection, shared roots and joint parameter adaptation.
Quadratic ablation is not a separately optimized quadratic architecture. A serious practical expressive-value claim may require that control and a cost-efficient quadratic implementation.
